info.title: Ascension harness-backed Context Console facade
info.description: Consumer transport for the bounded, in-process harness-owner composition. Every operation is implemented by HarnessBackedContextService; no legacy control-api operation is imported.

get.summary: Read capabilities for the configured scope
Read bounded eligible-item metadata and optional content

200.description: Direct array of sanitized eligible-item projections

get.summary: Read immutable revision metadata used by restore

post.summary: Create a draft from the expected active revision
Apply one bounded CAS patch to a known draft
Build a deterministic exploratory or held-boundary preview

get.summary: Enumerate or recover bounded owner command receipts
get.description: Without a recovery query, returns a bounded receipt array. With exactly one idempotency_key, reference_key, or reference query parameter, returns one recovered Receipt.

200.description: Bounded receipt array without a recovery query, or one recovered receipt when exactly one recovery query is supplied

get.summary: Recover one command receipt by the caller's idempotency key
get.x-recovery-key: caller idempotency key; owner command ID need not be known

bearerCapability.description: The bearer is supplied by protected middleware, scoped to one permission and run, and is never put in a URL.

IdempotencyKey.name: idempotency_key
IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-known command identity retained for receipt recovery.

IdempotencyKeyQuery.name: idempotency_key
IdempotencyKeyQuery.description: Recover one receipt by the caller-known idempotency key. Mutually exclusive with reference_key and reference.

ReferenceKeyQuery.name: reference_key
ReferenceKeyQuery.description: Compatibility alias for idempotency_key receipt recovery. Mutually exclusive with the other recovery query parameters.

ReferenceQuery.name: reference
ReferenceQuery.description: Compatibility alias for idempotency_key receipt recovery. Mutually exclusive with the other recovery query parameters.

Invalid.description: Invalid closed request or owner projection

Denied.description: Scope, origin, CSRF, or owner policy denied the operation

NotFound.description: Reference is not available in the configured scope

Expired.description: The caller capability or owner-issued reference has expired

TooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the 16 KiB facade bound

Stale.description: Cached or owner CAS version is stale

Unavailable.description: The owner capability or service is unavailable, or the serialized response exceeds the 16 KiB facade bound (`response_too_large`)

enum: host-owned state and legal catalog cannot be edited
